P01.desc: Shore house at dusk, one amber window (EXISTS: art/01-shore-house.png)

P02.desc: Close: two hands trimming an oil lamp's wick, a lit match, the first flame; cold blue kitchen around a small amber core

P03.desc: Outside, close on the frosted cottage window: the amber square glowing through frost and snow on the sill

P04.desc: Empty snowy road leaving a small town at blue dusk, a line of bare trees, no figures; a tiny amber window far down the road at center

P05.desc: Kitchen table by the window: two cups, one chair pulled out, the oil lamp; no person

P06.desc: Traveler seen from behind on a small ferry deck at night in sleet: dark wool coat, hood up, facing ahead over black water; the ferry's own lantern on a post

P07.desc: Harbor edge at night: ice along the quay, a few small town lights, a telegraph pole with sagging wires; cold, no amber except distant tiny windows

P08.desc: Night road by the shore: headlight beams sweeping past snow, the cottage window distant at center, unchanged

P09.desc: Close: the traveler's gloved hand on a frosted ferry rail; far ahead at center, one tiny amber point on a dark shore

P10.desc: Deep night, heavy snow: the cottage from the shore side, closer than P01, window still lit, snow piling on the sill and porch

P11.desc: Pre-dawn blue interior: the keeper asleep in a chair by the window, face turned away, blanket, the lamp burned low but lit

P12.desc: First light, seen from inside past the lamp on the sill: through the window, far out on dark water, a small boat's lantern answers. Lamp and lantern both within the central third so the 9:16 crop holds both

shots.cue: The kettle's cold / the road's a ribbon
I wiped the glass, I trimmed the wick
near or far / where you are
past the last of the trees
CHORUS 1: So I leave the light left on (first sight of the traveler)
If you lose the road… look for the light
The ferry's late, the wires are down

shots.move: slow pan across cups to chair
shots.cue: I set two cups, pulled out your chair

shots.move: slow push; headlight sweep if moving study allows
shots.cue: every car that slows its wheels
a yellow square at the world's end

shots.move: slow push to the amber point

shots.cue: look for the light left on
BRIDGE: if you don't come home tonight… this year
If you lose the road… look for the light
Look for the light left on (tag)

shots.move: very slow push, hold to the end, fade on last note
shots.cue: Far out on the water / a small light answers

short.note: Opens on the bridge's last half-second into the final chorus (P10 → P06 → P11 → P03 → P12) and ends on the two-light image while the outro line sounds. Every plate has its subject centered for the 9:16 crop. P12 must be checked in the actual tall crop.

rules.adjacent: No two adjacent shots share a plate (checked).
rules.chronology: P10–P12 (end stage) appear only after 128 s. Middle plates P05–P09 appear only from 49 s on, except P01, P02 and P03, which recur as the house-side anchor.
rules.alternation: Middle section alternates house side and traveler side.
